name: Bryan Goldberg
subject: Middlebury Sophomore, Hungry to Learn
body:
Hi Bryan,

My name is Max. I'm 20 years old and a sophomore at Middlebury building an AI startup. You co-founded Bleacher Report, sold it to Turner for $200M, then started Bustle Digital Group and built a media portfolio including Nylon, W Magazine, and Gawker.

I want to know how you think about starting a second company after a big exit. If you had 10 minutes to chat, I am hungry to learn. I promise I'll pay it forward!

Best,
Max
